22.description: The committee recommends approving changes to the 1st Avenue Bus Rapid Transit plan, including new dedicated lanes, more stations, and a loss of 61 parking stalls between 19th and 25th Street.

chips.text: Councillor Pearce questioned a decision based on a survey of only 10 people.
Businesses and customers along 1st Avenue will lose 61 parking stalls.
Delegates questioned the cost of the new concept plan and snow storage.
Business groups and property owners raised significant concerns about the plan.
Administration promised continued dialogue with businesses on snow clearing logistics.

21.description: Saskatoon will undertake three major construction projects on 25th Street, University Bridge, and College Drive this summer, causing significant traffic disruptions and detours across the city.

chips.text: University Bridge closed to public vehicles until mid-June; College Drive will have phased closures.
Access to University and Jim Patterson Children's Hospitals will be maintained.
